native_request_identity: Original upload Idempotency-Key plus actor/stable family/warehouse/parent type/parent UUID/file SHA-256. X-Request-ID traces the fenced command and is NOT the upload operation key.
proof: Read exact terminal attachment_upload_requests row and compare the complete returned upload receipt against the durable receipt, native HTTP status, original key, parent and scope. Audit only identity, outcome and receipt digest; never filename, raw form, note, bytes or credentials.
success: Only native SUCCEEDED / HTTP 201 is a successful OWNER_REQUEST. No second attachment is allocated on exact owner replay.

rejection.terminal: Only a verified native REJECTED receipt with HTTP 4xx may commit through the outer shift fence.
rejection.kpi: Excluded from successful_request_count. Existing immutable closure snapshots are not rewritten.
rejection.side_effects: Native quarantine/no-attachment semantics and HTTP error remain unchanged; not universal NOT_RECORDED evidence.
rejection.replay: Same original trace/key/fingerprint uses existing owner terminal replay and does not add a second journal entry or increment shift version again.

version: First terminal fenced operation increments shift version; earlier close-check is stale. Native receipt lookup is still GET-only and independently scoped.
not_a_durable_receipt: Pre-intent validation/auth error without native receipt is not manufactured as REJECTED. Other errors retain existing rollback behavior.
remaining_gate: Owner coverage remains PARTIAL_EXPLICIT_OWNER_PROTOCOLS, not a claim of complete async/upload/hardware coverage.
Crash/storage/5xx uncertainty coordination with the outer shift transaction still requires exact owner investigation; no new NOT_EXECUTED proof or blind retry is introduced.
Legacy uploads without X-Upload-Contract have no new proof guarantee.
App must retain UNKNOWN/pending local journals and must not infer CLEAN from an absent row or receipt.
No live owner smoke, flag enablement or production activation is authorized by this source patch.
